```{r}
library(cliomicplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggtext)
```

## Overview

In dermatological transcriptomics and translational medicine, differential expression studies rarely evaluate a single comparison in isolation. Instead, clinical investigations rely on a **series of contrasts**:

1. **Disease Phenotyping Triad**: Contrasting Atopic Dermatitis (AD) and Psoriasis (PSO) against Healthy Controls (HC), alongside direct head-to-head AD vs. PSO comparisons to dissect Th2 versus Th17/Th22 immunophenotypic divergence.
2. **Therapeutic Resolution**: Evaluating longitudinal and cross-cohort treatment response across targeted biologics (e.g., Dupilumab anti-IL4R$\alpha$, tralokinumab anti-IL13, cerdulatinib dual SYK/JAK, and SAR444727 RIPK1 inhibitor) to track the reversal of disease-driving expression signatures.

This vignette demonstrates the complete series of volcano plots using real clinical transcriptomics from NCBI GEO accession **GSE121212** and cross-cohort treatment meta-analyses. All figures are generated using `type_volcano()` with `cliplot()`.

---

## 1. The Dermatology GEO Series Datasets

The analysis integrates four curated differential expression contrasts bundled directly with **cliomicplot**:

| Contrast | Cohort / Technology | Primary Biological Question |
|---|---|---|
| **AD vs. Healthy** | NCBI GEO `GSE121212` (RNA-seq) | Th2 immune activation & epidermal barrier breakdown |
| **Psoriasis vs. Healthy** | NCBI GEO `GSE121212` (RNA-seq) | Th17 / IL-23 axis & antimicrobial hyper-induction |
| **AD vs. Psoriasis** | NCBI GEO `GSE121212` (RNA-seq) | Direct head-to-head Th2 vs. Th17 biomarker divergence |
| **Treatment Meta-Analysis** | Cross-cohort meta-analysis (5 active arms) | Systematic therapeutic normalization of skin pathology |

```{r data-load}
# Helper to resolve bundled datasets
resolve_data = function(filename) {
  pkg_path = system.file("extdata", filename, package = "cliomicplot")
  if (pkg_path != "" && file.exists(pkg_path)) return(pkg_path)
  fallback = file.path("..", "inst", "extdata", filename)
  if (file.exists(fallback)) return(fallback)
  fallback2 = file.path("inst", "extdata", filename)
  if (file.exists(fallback2)) return(fallback2)
  stop("Cannot locate ", filename)
}

series = readRDS(resolve_data("geo_dermatology_series_de.rds"))

# Inspect available contrasts
names(series)
```

Each contrast table provides HGNC gene symbols with effect estimates ($\log_2\text{FC}$), standard errors (`lfcSE`), raw p-values, and Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rates (`padj`).

---

## 2. Contrast 1: Atopic Dermatitis vs. Control Skin (GSE121212)

The formula `y ~ x` places significance ($-\log_{10} P_{\text{adj}}$) on the vertical axis and effect size ($\log_2\text{FC}$) on the horizontal axis:

```{r fig1-ad-vs-hc, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=5.2}
cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = series$ad_vs_hc,
        type  = type_volcano(
          pval_cutoff  = 0.01,
          fc_cutoff    = 1.5,
          point_size   = 1.8,
          point_alpha  = 0.60,
          label_genes  = c("SERPINB4", "CCL18", "S100A7", "LCE3A", "SPRR2G",
                           "ALOX15", "GPLD1", "IL20RA", "SPTLC3"),
          max_overlaps = 25
        ),
        palette = "nature",
        theme   = "nature",
        title   = "**Figure 1** — NCBI GEO GSE121212: Atopic Dermatitis vs. Healthy Skin",
        subtitle = "Bulk RNA-seq | FDR < 0.01, |log₂FC| > 1.50") +
  cli_markdown() +
  labs(tag = "a") +
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
```

### Biological Insights (AD vs. HC)
- **Epidermal Differentiation Complex (EDC)**: Genes within the 1q21 locus undergo compensatory hyper-keratinization, with marked upregulation of *LCE3A* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +7.25$), *LCE3D* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +5.09$), and *SPRR2G* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +4.42$).
- **Th2 Chemokines & Serpins**: *SERPINB4* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +6.45$, squamous cell carcinoma antigen 2) and *CCL18* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +4.59$, dendritic cell-derived chemokine).
- **Lipid Barrier Depletion**: Genes governing ceramide synthesis and membrane integrity are selectively downregulated: *SPTLC3* ($\log_2\text{FC} = -0.57$) and *GPLD1* ($\log_2\text{FC} = -0.90$).

---

## 3. Contrast 2: Psoriasis vs. Control Skin (GSE121212)

Psoriasis represents the canonical IL-23/Th17 cutaneous autoimmune disease. We examine the same GSE121212 cohort to capture the contrasting Th17 expression landscape:

```{r fig2-pso-vs-hc, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=5.2}
pso_labels = c("DEFB4A", "DEFB4B", "PI3", "S100A8", "S100A9", "SPRR2A", "KRT16", "NOS2")

cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = series$pso_vs_hc,
        type  = type_volcano(
          pval_cutoff  = 0.001,
          fc_cutoff    = 2.0,
          point_size   = 1.8,
          point_alpha  = 0.60,
          up_color     = "#D73027",
          down_color   = "#2B6CB0",
          ns_color     = "#C8CCD4",
          label_genes  = pso_labels,
          max_overlaps = 25,
          cutoff_region_alpha = 0.04
        ),
        palette = "nature",
        theme   = "nature",
        title   = "**Figure 2** — NCBI GEO GSE121212: Psoriasis vs. Healthy Skin",
        subtitle = "Bulk RNA-seq | FDR < 0.001, |log₂FC| > 2.00") +
  cli_markdown() +
  labs(tag = "b") +
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
```

### Biological Insights (PSO vs. HC)
- **Extreme Antimicrobial Peptide Induction**: Psoriasis lesions express massive amounts of beta-defensins: *DEFB4A* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +10.00$, $P_{\text{adj}} = 2.02 \times 10^{-75}$) and *DEFB4B* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +9.49$, $P_{\text{adj}} = 1.20 \times 10^{-67}$).
- **Neutrophil & Alarmins**: Calprotectin subunits *S100A8* and *S100A9*, alongside *PI3* (elafin, $\log_2\text{FC} = +7.21$).

---

## 4. Contrast 3: Direct Head-to-Head (AD vs. Psoriasis)

In clinical differential diagnosis and basket trials, distinguishing AD from Psoriasis on a molecular level is critical. Directly contrasting AD vs. PSO in GSE121212 isolates the specific Th2 vs. Th17 divergence:

```{r fig3-ad-vs-pso, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=5.2}
head_to_head_labels = c("ALOX15", "CCL18", "COL6A6", "COL4A4", "NOS2", "DEFB4A", "DEFB4B")

cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = series$ad_vs_pso,
        type  = type_volcano(
          pval_cutoff  = 0.001,
          fc_cutoff    = 1.5,
          point_size   = 1.8,
          point_alpha  = 0.60,
          up_color     = "#E64B35",
          down_color   = "#3C5488",
          ns_color     = "#C8CCD4",
          label_genes  = head_to_head_labels,
          max_overlaps = 25,
          cutoff_region_alpha = 0.04
        ),
        theme   = "cell",
        title   = "**Figure 3** — Head-to-Head Divergence: AD vs. Psoriasis",
        subtitle = "GSE121212 | Up = AD Enriched, Down = Psoriasis Enriched") +
  cli_markdown() +
  labs(tag = "c") +
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
```

### Molecular Discrimination
- **Positive log2FC (AD Enriched)**: *ALOX15* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +2.72$, $P_{\text{adj}} = 7.11 \times 10^{-29}$) and *CCL18* show strong preference for atopic dermatitis over psoriasis.
- **Negative log2FC (Psoriasis Enriched)**: *NOS2* (inducible nitric oxide synthase, $\log_2\text{FC} = -6.60$, $P_{\text{adj}} = 3.18 \times 10^{-56}$) and *DEFB4A* are selectively enriched in psoriasis.

---

## 5. Contrast 4: Cross-Cohort Treatment Meta-Analysis

Effective therapy reverses the baseline disease signature. Here we evaluate the cross-cohort random-effects meta-analysis across active treatment arms (dupilumab, cerdulatinib, SAR444727, SB414):

```{r fig4-treatment-meta, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=5.2}
treat_labels = c("TK1", "AQP3", "TOP2A", "NUSAP1", "ECT2", "DIAPH3")

cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = series$treatment_meta,
        type  = type_volcano(
          pval_cutoff  = 0.01,
          fc_cutoff    = 0.5,
          point_size   = 1.7,
          point_alpha  = 0.60,
          up_color     = "#E64B35",
          down_color   = "#00A087",
          ns_color     = "#C8CCD4",
          label_genes  = treat_labels,
          max_overlaps = 25,
          cutoff_region_alpha = 0.04
        ),
        theme   = "nature",
        title   = "**Figure 4** — Active Treatment Meta-Analysis: Therapeutic Normalization",
        subtitle = "Cross-Study Meta-Analysis | Negative logFC = Disease Reversal") +
  cli_markdown() +
  labs(tag = "d") +
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
```

Under effective treatment, hyper-proliferative keratinocyte and mitotic machinery genes are systematically suppressed: *TK1* ($\text{meta-LFC} = -0.80$, $P_{\text{adj}} = 2.59 \times 10^{-11}$), *AQP3* ($\text{meta-LFC} = -0.96$), and *TOP2A* ($\text{meta-LFC} = -0.67$).

---

## 6. The Aligned Multi-Panel Volcano Series

In journal articles, presenting these four contrasts as a coordinated $2 \times 2$ grid provides a comprehensive overview of disease etiology, diagnostic divergence, and therapeutic response:

```{r fig5-series-composite, fig.width=10.5, fig.height=9.2}
p_a = cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = series$ad_vs_hc,
              type = type_volcano(pval_cutoff = 0.01, fc_cutoff = 1.5, point_size = 1.5,
                                  label_genes = c("SERPINB4", "CCL18", "LCE3A", "SPTLC3"),
                                  max_overlaps = 15),
              palette = "nature", theme = "nature",
              title = "Atopic Dermatitis vs. Healthy", subtitle = "GSE121212 | Th2 & Barrier")

p_b = cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = series$pso_vs_hc,
              type = type_volcano(pval_cutoff = 0.001, fc_cutoff = 2.0, point_size = 1.5,
                                  label_genes = c("DEFB4A", "DEFB4B", "PI3", "S100A8"),
                                  max_overlaps = 15),
              palette = "nature", theme = "nature",
              title = "Psoriasis vs. Healthy", subtitle = "GSE121212 | Th17 & Defensins")

p_c = cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = series$ad_vs_pso,
              type = type_volcano(pval_cutoff = 0.001, fc_cutoff = 1.5, point_size = 1.5,
                                  label_genes = c("ALOX15", "CCL18", "NOS2", "DEFB4A"),
                                  max_overlaps = 15),
              palette = "nature", theme = "nature",
              title = "AD vs. Psoriasis", subtitle = "GSE121212 | Head-to-Head")

p_d = cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = series$treatment_meta,
              type = type_volcano(pval_cutoff = 0.01, fc_cutoff = 0.5, point_size = 1.5,
                                  label_genes = c("TK1", "AQP3", "TOP2A", "ECT2"),
                                  max_overlaps = 15),
              palette = "nature", theme = "nature",
              title = "Treatment Meta-Analysis", subtitle = "Active Therapies | Normalization")

# Assemble 2x2 grid with unified legend and panel tags
((p_a | p_b) / (p_c | p_d)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
```

---

## 7. Dual Biomarker Call-Out (*CCL18* vs. *NOS2*)

To highlight opposing immunological trajectories, we place rich annotation cards onto lead candidate biomarkers:

```{r fig6-biomarker-callout, fig.width=8.5, fig.height=5.8}
# Prepare annotation card for CCL18
hl_ccl18 = series$ad_vs_hc["CCL18", ]
hl_ccl18$ci_low  = round(hl_ccl18$log2FC - 1.96 * hl_ccl18$lfcSE, 2)
hl_ccl18$ci_high = round(hl_ccl18$log2FC + 1.96 * hl_ccl18$lfcSE, 2)

hl_ccl18$annot = paste0(
  "<b><i>CCL18</i></b> (AD Biomarker)<br>",
  "<b>log₂FC = +", round(hl_ccl18$log2FC, 2), "</b> (", round(2^hl_ccl18$log2FC, 1), "× fold increase)<br>",
  "95% CI: [", hl_ccl18$ci_low, ", ", hl_ccl18$ci_high, "]<br>",
  "<b>FDR = 4.04 × 10<sup>-32</sup></b><br>",
  "<span style='font-size:8pt;color:#555;'>Th2 Chemokine / Severity marker</span>"
)

p_base = cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = series$ad_vs_hc,
  type = type_volcano(
    pval_cutoff  = 0.01,
    fc_cutoff    = 1.5,
    point_size   = 1.8,
    point_alpha  = 0.55,
    label_genes  = c("SERPINB4", "S100A7", "LCE3A", "GPLD1", "SPTLC3"),
    max_overlaps = 20
  ),
  palette = "nature", theme = "nature",
  title   = "**Figure 6** — Volcano Plot with *CCL18* Lead Biomarker Call-Out",
  subtitle = "NCBI GEO GSE121212 | Human Skin Biopsies") +
  cli_markdown()

p_annot = p_base +
  geom_point(
    data = hl_ccl18,
    aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(padj)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 21, size = 4.5, stroke = 1.3,
    fill = "#C95C43", colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_richtext(
    data = hl_ccl18,
    aes(x = log2FC - 4.8, y = -log10(padj) + 2.5, label = annot),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
    size = 3.1, fill = "#FDF2E9", colour = "black",
    label.colour = "#C95C43", label.padding = grid::unit(c(5, 7, 5, 7), "pt")
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = hl_ccl18,
    aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(padj),
        xend = log2FC - 1.4, yend = -log10(padj) + 1.8),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#555555"
  )

p_annot
```

---

## 8. Publication Dimensions & Vector Export

`cli_journal_size()` provides column specifications for target publishers:

```{r export-demo, eval = FALSE}
# Single-column Nature layout (89 mm)
cli_journal_size("nature", "single")

# Export high-resolution vector PDF
cli_save(p_annot, "Figure_Volcano_CCL18.pdf", journal = "nature", column = "single")

# Export multi-panel 2x2 grid for Cell Press double-column layout (174 mm)
cli_save((p_a | p_b) / (p_c | p_d), "Figure_Volcano_Series.svg", journal = "cell", column = "double")
```

---

## Summary

| Contrast | Hallmark Up-Regulated | Hallmark Down-Regulated | Immunological Driver |
|---|---|---|---|
| **AD vs. Healthy** | *SERPINB4*, *CCL18*, *LCE3A*, *SPRR2G*, *S100A7* | *SPTLC3*, *GPLD1*, *IL20RA* | IL-4 / IL-13 (Th2) & barrier defect |
| **PSO vs. Healthy** | *DEFB4A*, *DEFB4B*, *PI3*, *S100A8*, *S100A9*, *NOS2* | *DIPK2A*, *PRELID2* | IL-17A / IL-23 / TNF (Th17) |
| **AD vs. PSO** | *ALOX15*, *CCL18*, *COL6A6* | *NOS2*, *DEFB4A*, *DEFB4B* | Th2 vs. Th17 phenotypic divergence |
| **Treatment Meta** | Normalization of physiological baselines | *TK1*, *AQP3*, *TOP2A*, *NUSAP1*, *ECT2* | Anti-inflammatory resolution |
